IVX IA CHAT — PRODUCTION FAILURE AUDIT + CONVERSATION INTELLIGENCE +
LATENCY + COMPOSER + LOADING STATE + END-TO-END QA REPAIR

THIS TASK OVERRIDES ANY PREVIOUS "10/10", "CERTIFIED", "COMPLETE",
OR "END-TO-END VERIFIED" STATUS FOR IVX IA CHAT.

CURRENT LIVE EVIDENCE SHOWS THE CHAT IS NOT COMPLETE.

DO NOT ISSUE ANOTHER CERTIFICATE UNTIL THE REAL PRODUCTION USER FLOW
DESCRIBED BELOW PASSES FROM THE ACTUAL IVX MOBILE/WEB UI.

========================================================
CURRENT VERIFIED FAILURE EVIDENCE
========================================================

Observed production watchdog state:

USER_ROW_INSERTED = reached

AI_TRIGGER_DECISION = failed

Error:
Timed out after 90000ms — no progress past USER_ROW_INSERTED.

Observed file:
expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx

Observed function:
sendMessageMutation
auto-trigger branch

Observed watchdog nextFix:

send_and_ai branch did not run.

Investigate:
- command prefix detection
- localFirstChatMode
- elevated confirmation early-return
- any branch preventing AI invocation after USER_ROW_INSERTED

Observed production UX failures:

1. IVX IA can take approximately 90 seconds or more to answer.

2. A user message can successfully enter the conversation database/UI
   while AI processing never begins.

3. The user message remains inside the composer/input after Send.

4. The submitted message also appears as a chat bubble,
   creating duplicated visual state.

5. The composer is not cleared immediately after successful send.

6. A large loading/spinner icon overlays the submitted user bubble.

7. There are multiple competing loading states:
   - watchdog working
   - Still working card
   - bubble spinner
   - composer state

8. Loading states do not appear to share one canonical request state.

9. IVX IA sometimes responds to something other than the user's actual
   conversational intent.

Example:

User:
"I ask what date I create you?"

Assistant:
"This will change code and deploy to production.
Do you authorize me to run this end-to-end?"

This is a conversational-routing failure.

The user asked an informational/conversational question.

It should not have been classified as a code execution request.

10. Follow-up correction:

"Answer that i not asking you"

also became stuck in the send/AI-trigger path.

Therefore the problem is NOT merely AI model quality.

It is an end-to-end architecture/routing/state/context problem.

========================================================
PRIMARY OBJECTIVE
========================================================

Audit and repair the complete IVX IA Chat path:

USER TYPES
↓
USER PRESSES SEND
↓
LOCAL UI STATE
↓
MESSAGE INSERT
↓
AI INTENT CLASSIFICATION
↓
CONVERSATION CONTEXT ASSEMBLY
↓
SYSTEM / IVX BUSINESS BRAIN PROMPT
↓
MODEL REQUEST
↓
MODEL RESPONSE
↓
ASSISTANT ROW INSERT
↓
REAL-TIME/UI UPDATE
↓
FINAL REQUEST CLEANUP

Every stage must have explicit evidence.

Do not skip directly to changing the prompt.

========================================================
PART 1 — BUILD A REAL TRACE OF ONE CHAT MESSAGE
========================================================

Instrument one actual production/dev-equivalent message end to end.

Create a traceId at Send.

The same traceId must follow:

SEND_CLICKED
USER_LOCAL_CREATED
USER_ROW_INSERT_STARTED
USER_ROW_INSERTED
AI_TRIGGER_STARTED
AI_TRIGGER_DECISION
CONTEXT_BUILD_STARTED
CONTEXT_BUILD_COMPLETE
MODEL_REQUEST_STARTED
MODEL_FIRST_TOKEN
MODEL_RESPONSE_COMPLETE
ASSISTANT_ROW_INSERT_STARTED
ASSISTANT_ROW_INSERTED
UI_ASSISTANT_RENDERED
REQUEST_FINISHED

For each checkpoint capture:

timestamp
elapsedMs
conversationId
messageId
traceId
route/branch
success/failure
error if present

Do NOT log sensitive message contents into production telemetry unless
the existing privacy design explicitly permits it.

========================================================
PART 2 — FIX THE CURRENT AI_TRIGGER_DECISION FAILURE
========================================================

Start specifically with:

expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx

sendMessageMutation

Inspect the real auto-trigger branch.

Determine exactly why:

USER_ROW_INSERTED

does NOT reliably transition to:

AI_TRIGGER_DECISION

Audit all early-return conditions, especially:

command prefix logic
localFirstChatMode
manual/automatic AI modes
elevated confirmation logic
owner mode
send_and_ai path
send_only path
pending mutation state
conversation permissions
user role
message status
watchdog state

Create a deterministic decision function.

Example concept:

determineMessageAction(message, context)

returns exactly one of:

CHAT_REPLY
ACTION_REQUEST
NEEDS_CONFIRMATION
SEND_ONLY
BLOCKED

Do not spread decision logic through multiple UI callbacks.

========================================================
PART 3 — SEPARATE CHAT FROM ACTION EXECUTION
========================================================

This is critical.

A normal conversational message MUST NOT accidentally enter the
code/deploy/action authorization workflow.

Examples:

"What date did I create you?"
"What did we discuss yesterday?"
"What remains?"
"Why is this taking so long?"
"Explain this error."
"Which project should we prioritize?"

These are CHAT_REPLY unless the user's actual request clearly asks for
an external/destructive/tool action.

Action confirmation should be required only for actions that genuinely
require approval under the project's permission model.

Do not treat:

questions
analysis
status requests
explanations
follow-up conversation

as execution requests.

Test this explicitly.

========================================================
PART 4 — CONVERSATION NARRATIVE / CONTEXT FAILURE
========================================================

Audit exactly what context reaches the model.

For every normal IVX IA reply, inspect the request assembly.

Determine whether the model receives:

1. IVX IA system/business-brain prompt
2. current conversation/thread identifier
3. prior user messages
4. prior assistant messages
5. relevant project memory/context
6. latest user message
7. active task state where relevant

Verify message ordering.

Expected:

SYSTEM
previous conversation messages in chronological order
LATEST USER MESSAGE

Check for bugs where:

- only latest user message is sent
- conversation history is missing
- history is sent in reverse order
- wrong conversationId is used
- old task instructions override current conversation
- watchdog/recovery prompts become user context
- previous developer execution task remains the active intent
- stale cached context is reused
- current user message gets lost during async state update
- system persona replaces instead of supplements conversation history

========================================================
PART 5 — FOLLOW-UP INTENT MUST USE CONVERSATION
========================================================

IVX IA must understand follow-up messages.

Example:

User:
"What date did I create you?"

Assistant gives wrong answer.

User:
"Answer that, I'm not asking you to deploy."

Expected:

IVX IA understands that "that" refers to the immediately preceding
question and answers the original question.

Do not require the user to restate the whole prompt.

Test pronouns and conversational references:

that
it
this
why
what about that
continue
do the other one
no, I mean...
answer my question

========================================================
PART 6 — COMPOSER SEND BEHAVIOR
========================================================

The current UX is wrong.

When user presses Send:

1. Capture composer text into an immutable outgoingMessage variable.

2. Immediately create optimistic/local message state if architecture
   supports it.

3. Immediately clear the composer.

4. The text MUST NOT remain in the typing field while waiting for IVX IA.

5. The user message bubble must remain in conversation history.

6. The composer becomes ready for the next message immediately.

Correct behavior:

Before send:
composer = "Answer that I'm not asking you"

After tap Send:
composer = ""

conversation:
[User bubble]
Answer that I'm not asking you

AI status:
Thinking / working

The composer must NOT contain the previously submitted text.

If send fails:

Do NOT automatically put stale text back into the composer.

Instead mark the message:

FAILED / RETRY

with controlled retry UX.

========================================================
PART 7 — REMOVE THE LARGE LOADING ICON FROM USER MESSAGE
========================================================

Remove the large circular spinner overlay from the submitted user bubble.

A sent user message should not be visually covered by a blocking spinner.

Use message delivery states instead:

SENDING
SENT
FAILED

Represent them subtly.

For example:

small status text/icon near timestamp

Do not obscure message content.

========================================================
PART 8 — ONE CANONICAL AI LOADING STATE
========================================================

There are currently too many independent activity indicators.

Unify the state machine.

Suggested request states:

IDLE
SENDING_USER
WAITING_FOR_AI
STREAMING
COMPLETED
FAILED
CANCELLED

UI must derive from this one source.

Do NOT independently maintain:

mutation loading
watchdog loading
bubble spinner
Still working timer
AI processing boolean
send button loading

unless they are derived from the canonical state.

Expected:

User presses Send
↓
brief SENDING_USER
↓
WAITING_FOR_AI
↓
STREAMING
↓
COMPLETED

Watchdog is diagnostic.

It must not become a second competing source of product state.

========================================================
PART 9 — "STILL WORKING" UX
========================================================

Do not show "Still working..." immediately at 2–3 seconds as though the
system is already abnormal.

Normal conversational replies should have a lightweight thinking state.

Suggested thresholds based on measured production latency:

0–X sec:
normal assistant thinking state

after verified slow threshold:
"Still working..."

after timeout threshold:
controlled error/retry state

Do not choose thresholds arbitrarily.

Measure actual backend/model latency first.

========================================================
PART 10 — 90 SECOND TIMEOUT ROOT CAUSE
========================================================

Do not "fix" this by increasing 90000ms to a larger number.

The current evidence says:

NO PROGRESS PAST USER_ROW_INSERTED

That means the immediate problem may happen BEFORE the model request.

Measure separately:

T1 send click -> user row inserted

T2 user row inserted -> AI trigger decision

T3 AI trigger -> context ready

T4 context ready -> model request start

T5 model request -> first token

T6 first token -> complete

T7 complete -> assistant rendered

Report actual numbers.

Find which segment consumes the delay.

========================================================
PART 11 — MODEL STREAMING
========================================================

If the current model/API supports safe streaming in the established
architecture, verify whether IVX IA can render first tokens progressively.

Do not wait for a full long response before showing anything if the
existing backend architecture supports streaming.

Measure:

time-to-request
time-to-first-token
time-to-complete

Do not claim streaming exists unless verified.

========================================================
PART 12 — PREVENT DUPLICATE SENDS
========================================================

Protect against:

double tap
network retry
component rerender
mutation retry
watchdog recovery
real-time subscription replay

Each user send should have a client-generated idempotency identifier.

One tap must produce:

ONE user message row

ONE AI trigger

ONE assistant response

unless the product explicitly supports multiple agents.

========================================================
PART 13 — CANCEL BEHAVIOR
========================================================

The Cancel button must cancel the AI operation, not corrupt the
conversation.

After Cancel:

user message remains
AI request stops if technically cancellable
state becomes CANCELLED
composer remains usable
next message can be sent normally
no zombie assistant response should later attach unexpectedly

Test it.

========================================================
PART 14 — WATCHDOG ROLE
========================================================

Keep the watchdog as diagnostics.

But separate:

PRODUCT UI STATE

from:

DEVELOPER DIAGNOSTIC STATE

The large red watchdog card can exist in developer/admin diagnostic mode.

It should not control the conversation lifecycle.

Ensure watchdog timeout cannot itself create another permanent
"Still working" state.

========================================================
PART 15 — SYSTEM PROMPT / IVX BUSINESS BRAIN
========================================================

Verify the v8 business-intelligence persona is actually part of the
request used by the production chat route.

Do not merely inspect a file and assume it is used.

Trace:

chat.tsx
↓
API call
↓
backend route
↓
context assembler
↓
system/persona loader
↓
model client

Prove that the production request uses the intended system prompt.

========================================================
PART 16 — CONTEXT WINDOW MANAGEMENT
========================================================

If conversations become long, do not arbitrarily truncate the most
important recent history.

Document the actual context policy.

Prioritize:

system instructions
current user request
recent conversation turns
relevant persistent project context
relevant summarized older history

Do not allow old unrelated execution instructions to dominate the
current question.

========================================================
PART 17 — REAL CONVERSATIONAL QA
========================================================

Do NOT QA only with isolated single prompts.

Run a multi-turn conversation.

TEST A — FOLLOW-UP

User:
"What date did I create you?"

Assistant responds.

User:
"No, answer the date I created IVX IA."

Expected:
Understands follow-up context.

--------------------------------

TEST B — CORRECTION

User asks informational question.

If assistant misunderstands:

User:
"That's not what I'm asking."

Expected:
Assistant reinterprets the previous user intent.

Must NOT start deployment authorization.

--------------------------------

TEST C — TECHNICAL

User:
"Why is chat taking so long?"

Expected:
Explain/audit.

Must NOT ask for deployment authorization merely because the topic
contains software.

--------------------------------

TEST D — ACTION

User:
"Fix this bug and deploy it."

Expected:
Recognizes an action request and follows applicable execution/
authorization policy.

This proves chat vs action intent works.

--------------------------------

TEST E — BUSINESS

User:
"What's blocking revenue right now?"

Expected:
Business-brain analysis using available context.

--------------------------------

TEST F — MEMORY

Ask about something stated several messages earlier.

Expected:
Correctly uses conversation context.

--------------------------------

TEST G — RAPID MESSAGES

Send message A.

While AI is working, send message B if product design allows it.

Ensure:

messages remain ordered
composer clears each time
responses attach correctly
no cross-message contamination

========================================================
PART 18 — UI QA
========================================================

Verify on the real mobile viewport shown by production:

- no large spinner covering user bubble
- composer clears immediately
- user bubble remains
- send button behaves correctly
- status indicator is understandable
- Cancel works
- scrolling remains stable
- assistant reply appears under correct user message
- no layout jump
- no duplicate message
- no stuck "Sending"
- no stuck "Still working"
- no permanent watchdog state after success

========================================================
PART 19 — LATENCY ACCEPTANCE
========================================================

Do not invent a speed target.

First establish baseline using real traces.

Report median and worst observed time for:

send -> USER_ROW_INSERTED
USER_ROW_INSERTED -> AI_TRIGGER_DECISION
AI_TRIGGER_DECISION -> MODEL_REQUEST
MODEL_REQUEST -> FIRST_TOKEN
FIRST_TOKEN -> COMPLETE

The key acceptance condition is:

NO NORMAL CHAT MESSAGE MAY SPEND 90 SECONDS WAITING AT
USER_ROW_INSERTED WITHOUT AI_TRIGGER_DECISION.

A stalled trigger should fail fast with an actionable diagnostic rather
than making the user wait 90 seconds.

========================================================
PART 20 — SOURCE AUDIT
========================================================

Inspect all relevant actual files.

At minimum begin with:

expo/app/ivx/chat.tsx

Then trace real imports/services used for:

sendMessageMutation
message insert
AI auto-trigger
AI backend call
conversation context
system prompt
model client
realtime message updates
watchdog
loading state
composer state

Report exact file paths.

Do not invent architecture.

========================================================
PART 21 — TESTS
========================================================

Add/repair automated tests for:

1. composer clears after Send
2. outgoing text preserved in user bubble
3. one send = one user row
4. one user row = one AI trigger
5. normal question routes CHAT_REPLY
6. action request routes ACTION_REQUEST
7. follow-up maintains conversation context
8. latest user message included
9. prior turns included in correct order
10. AI_TRIGGER_DECISION always resolves or fails deterministically
11. early-return paths are intentional
12. cancellation cleanup
13. timeout cleanup
14. no permanent loading state
15. retry works
16. stale response cannot attach to wrong message
17. watchdog reflects actual pipeline state
18. user spinner overlay removed

========================================================
PART 22 — PROOF-FIRST QA
========================================================

For every claimed PASS provide real evidence.

Required:

file path
test name
command
exit code
actual trace
actual HTTP response where applicable
actual timing
actual production behavior

Do not fabricate evidence.

If not executed:
UNVERIFIED

========================================================
PART 23 — INVALIDATE OLD CERTIFICATE
========================================================

The previous 10/10 certification is NOT sufficient evidence because the
actual production UX shown by the user contradicts it.

Explain exactly why the previous QA failed to catch:

AI_TRIGGER_DECISION timeout
wrong conversational routing
composer not clearing
spinner overlay
90-second stall
context/follow-up failure

Determine whether previous QA tested:

backend endpoints only

OR

real user-facing send -> response path.

This distinction must appear in the final report.

========================================================
PART 24 — REAL END-TO-END CERTIFICATION
========================================================

A valid IVX IA Chat certification must include:

REAL UI
↓
REAL SEND BUTTON
↓
REAL USER MESSAGE
↓
REAL DATABASE INSERT
↓
REAL AI TRIGGER
↓
REAL CONTEXT
↓
REAL MODEL RESPONSE
↓
REAL ASSISTANT INSERT
↓
REAL UI RENDER

Backend-only endpoint tests are not end-to-end certification.

========================================================
PART 25 — FINAL LIVE TEST
========================================================

After implementation/deployment, reproduce this exact scenario from the
actual production UI:

Message 1:
"What date did I create you?"

Confirm:
- composer clears immediately
- message stays as user bubble
- no giant spinner covers it
- AI_TRIGGER_DECISION occurs
- assistant answers the question conversationally
- no deployment authorization prompt appears unless actually relevant

Message 2:
"Answer that, I'm not asking you to deploy."

Confirm:
- composer clears immediately
- IVX understands "that"
- IVX references prior conversation correctly
- no 90-second USER_ROW_INSERTED stall
- assistant response attaches correctly
- loading UI returns to idle

========================================================
PART 26 — FINAL MATRIX
========================================================

Return:

01 Send button                   PASS/FAIL
02 Composer clears              PASS/FAIL
03 User bubble persists         PASS/FAIL
04 Spinner overlay removed      PASS/FAIL
05 USER_ROW_INSERT              PASS/FAIL
06 AI_TRIGGER_DECISION          PASS/FAIL
07 Chat/action routing          PASS/FAIL
08 Context history              PASS/FAIL
09 Latest message context       PASS/FAIL
10 Follow-up understanding      PASS/FAIL
11 Business brain persona       PASS/FAIL
12 Model request                PASS/FAIL
13 First-token latency          PASS/FAIL
14 Assistant insert             PASS/FAIL
15 Realtime render              PASS/FAIL
16 Loading state cleanup        PASS/FAIL
17 Cancel                       PASS/FAIL
18 Timeout handling             PASS/FAIL
19 Duplicate protection         PASS/FAIL
20 Production mobile QA         PASS/FAIL

Allowed status values only:

PASS
FAIL
BLOCKED
UNVERIFIED

========================================================
PART 27 — FINAL REPORT
========================================================

Return:

ROOT CAUSE

Why AI_TRIGGER_DECISION stopped after USER_ROW_INSERTED.

CONVERSATION GAP

Why IVX IA did not follow the user's actual conversation.

LATENCY BREAKDOWN

Measured timing per pipeline stage.

UI ROOT CAUSE

Why composer text remained and why spinner appeared.

FILES MODIFIED

Exact paths.

TESTS

Commands + exit codes.

DEPLOYMENT

Real commit/PR/deployment evidence.

LIVE QA

Actual production traces.

PREVIOUS CERTIFICATE GAP

Why previous "10/10" did not represent actual end-to-end UX.

REMAINING FAILURES

Exact list or NONE.

========================================================
CERTIFICATION RULE
========================================================

DO NOT say:

10/10
100%
CERTIFIED
END-TO-END COMPLETE
PRODUCTION VERIFIED

unless the real production UI flow passes all critical checks above.

A backend endpoint returning HTTP 200 is NOT sufficient.

A successful model API response is NOT sufficient.

A database insert is NOT sufficient.

A synthetic test is NOT sufficient.

The full user-facing path must work.

FINAL ACCEPTANCE:

USER SEND: PASS
COMPOSER CLEAR: PASS
USER MESSAGE PERSISTS: PASS
NO BLOCKING SPINNER: PASS
AI TRIGGER: PASS
CONVERSATION CONTEXT: PASS
FOLLOW-UP UNDERSTANDING: PASS
CHAT VS ACTION ROUTING: PASS
RESPONSE LATENCY: PASS
ASSISTANT RESPONSE: PASS
LOADING CLEANUP: PASS
PRODUCTION MOBILE FLOW: PASS

Only then:

IVX IA CHAT — REAL END-TO-END VERIFIED COMPLETE
